newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies limit-up late, hogs rise.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies limit-up late, hogs rise.

text.p: CME pork belly futures extended gains in late trading, with February and March contracts up the three-cent limit.
Hog futures also extended gains on continued reaction to higher cash hog prices Wednesday and Thursday and talk that meat packers need hogs for Saturday slaughter operations.
Traders said ED&F Man and R.J. O'Brien were featured buyers of large amounts of February pork bellies. Traders said buying from both firms appeared to be both short-covering and new long positions.
